channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Pesquisa para presidente em SP no 1º turno: veja números recentes
item.description: A recent Datafolha poll for the 2026 presidential race in São Paulo shows a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the first round. Both candidates are close in numbers in the state, keeping the race balanced.

item.title: TSE determina que votos em Garotinho sejam considerados nulos no Rio
item.description: The TSE ruled that votes cast for Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) for Governor of Rio de Janeiro must be considered null and void. The decision was made by Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques.

item.title: Preço do diesel dispara na reta final do 1º turno
item.description: The price of S10 diesel reached R$ 7.35 per liter in the final stretch before the 2026 first-round election, the highest since April, driven by global supply constraints and Brazil's dependence on imports, especially from the US. The surge directly impacts freight transport and the Brazilian economy, which imports between 25% and 30% of its diesel consumption.

item.title: Debate da Globo cancelado: como TSE e STF implodiram o último confronto
item.description: TV Globo canceled the final 2026 presidential debate 40 minutes before broadcast due to conflicting judicial rulings from TSE and STF regarding candidate participation. Minister Estela Aranha banned Lula's empty pulpit, while Justice Gilmar Mendes mandated Renan Santos (Mission) inclusion, prompting Flávio Bolsonaro's withdrawal.

item.title: Toffoli manda somar tempo de TV a governador do Ceará
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Dias Toffoli ordered radio and TV stations in Ceará to provide additional electoral advertising time to the coalition of Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT), who is running for re-election, even within the 48 hours prior to the election. The ruling aims to ensure equal conditions for electoral dissemination, in line with Supreme Court guidelines. The decision was published on Friday, November 2nd.

item.title: Ato com Lula em BH tem provocação a Nikolas Ferreira
item.description: During a Petrobras campaign rally in Belo Horizonte, First Lady Janja da Silva and activists publicly provoked federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), using offensive language and banners referencing the lawmaker directly. Tensions between the two political groups escalated with retaliatory attacks during public demonstrations held on consecutive days.

item.title: Governo brasileiro reconhece violações na Nicarágua, mas nega ameaça
item.description: The OAS approved a resolution demanding the release of political prisoners in Nicaragua, which Brazil supported but opposed characterizing as a 'regional threat,' stressing such a designation belongs to the UN. Brazilian ambassador Ricardo Belli labeled the violations as serious but criticized pretexts for colonial interventions and the 'peace through force' logic.

item.title: Lula diz estar “convicto” de aprovação da PEC do fim da 6x1 no Senado
item.description: President Lula expressed confidence that the Senate will approve the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule, following its inclusion on the plenary agenda. TheMeasure, a government priority, requires two Senate votes with at least 49 favorable votes each.

item.title: CNDH pede monitoramento à Comissão Interamericana e cita Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: The National Council of Human Rights (CNDH) requested the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights and the Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression to monitor potential risks to religious and expression freedoms during the 2026 elections. The initiative references controversial statements by officials linked to the Bolsonaro government, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and vice-presidential candidate Hamilton Mourão. The council emphasized the importance of ensuring everyone's right to freely express their beliefs without persecution or censorship during the electoral period.

item.title: Agência Brasil e veículos da EBC fazem cobertura especial das eleições
item.description: EBC conducts integrated, multiplatform special coverage of the 2026 elections, centered on the theme 'Public Journalism in Service of Democracy'. TV Brasil, Agência Brasil, and Rádio Nacional provide live coverage of voting and vote counting, integrated with RNCP partner stations. The coverage includes analyses, official TSE data, and updates on measures like Pix payments to poll workers and energy grid preparations.

item.title: Alcione pede voto para Lula entre eleitores com mais de 70 anos
item.description: Singer Alcione posted a video on social media urging voters over 70 years old to vote for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 presidential election, emphasizing the decisive role of this demographic despite voting being optional. She highlighted that the election concerns issues such as education, minimum wage, and social policies under Lula's government, including Pé de Meia and Farmácia Popular. Alcione's appeal aligns with Lula's own calls for elderly citizens to participate in the vote.

item.title: Veja os números dos candidatos a governador em SP
item.description: Five candidates run for São Paulo governor in 2026. Izadora Dias (PCO) had candidacy denied by Electoral Court after party slate rejection; TSE upheld decision on September 30. Name may still appear, but votes will count as null.

item.title: Damares diz que Bolsonaro passou mal e que Michelle está “presa” com o ex-presidente
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (PL) claimed that former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL) fell ill at home on Friday, 2, during a campaign event in Brasília. She stated that Michelle Bolsonaro could not attend the event and is 'stuck' taking care of the former president. The statement was made in a video posted on the senator's Instagram account.

item.title: Espólio de Caiado, caso Master e agro: como serão as disputas ao governo no Centro-Oeste do Brasil
item.description: Center-West elections are influenced by the Banco Master scandal and BRB crisis, favoring candidates aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro. Celina Leão leads in the Federal District, while Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul show complex scenarios with potential wins for Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: Região Norte: saiba como serão as disputas a governador onde só um candidato é do PT
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil's Northern Region are expected to favor the right wing, with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) strengthening his influence in states such as Acre, Pará, Rondônia, and Roraima. The PT, on the other hand, maintains only one gubernatorial candidacy in the region, with Expedito Netto in Tocantins, reflecting a significant strategic disadvantage for the party. The electoral competition is marked by the absence of direct support from Lula in several northern states.

item.title: Região Sul: como vai ser a votação para governador nos Estados onde o PL de Flávio domina as urnas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's PL leads gubernatorial polls in Brazil's Southern region, with strong chances in Paraná and Rio Grande do Sul, while PT has no own candidates there. This scenario benefits PL, potentially allowing first-round wins and reducing Lula's influence.

item.title: Haddad critica ausência de Tarcísio em debates e diz que campanha ‘mostrou vulnerabilidades’
item.description: Haddad criticizes Tarcísio's absence from debates and points to vulnerabilities in security, health, and education. According to Datafolha, Tarcísio leads with 50% of the votes, against 33% for Haddad. The campaign ends with an event in ABC Paulista, strengthening the PT base.

item.title: Cury avalia pedir adiamento do primeiro turno
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) states that his team is considering filing a writ of mandate to request a one-week postponement of the first round, claiming that the cancellation of the Globo TV debate harmed his campaign.

item.title: 5 maiores doadores de 2026 destinaram R$ 22 milhões a candidatos
item.description: The five largest donors in the 2026 elections contributed R$22.42 million to candidates and parties, according to the TSE's DivulgaCand system. Rubens Ometto leads with R$6 million, followed by Carlos Suarez with R$5.74 million, highlighting the continued influence of individual donors after the 2015 ban on corporate contributions.

item.title: Governo brasileiro soube com antecedência de fechamento de embaixada e consulados dos EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government stated it was informed in advance of the US decision to suspend consular services in Brazil due to security concerns and is monitoring the situation. The suspension, announced on October 2, affects the embassy in Brasília and consulates in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Recife, and Porto Alegre. The measure occurs before the first round of elections, but the government says the electoral process will not be affected.

item.title: Crusoé: O triste fim da candidatura de Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, saw his campaign collapse after being manipulated on the eve of the first round. His candidacy, initially linked to political renewal targeting youth and opposed to both Bolsonarism and Lulism, ended in a tragic and unusual manner.

item.title: Red Bull e realme levam gaming mobile às universidades
item.description: realme and Red Bull launch the Red Bull Wings Cup, a university tournament combining football and mobile gaming, with activities at various Brazilian universities until October 31st. The initiative includes the realme Campus Tour with EA FC 27 Mobile competitions, and creates Brazil's first 'realme Gaming Community' along with 'realme Campus Gamer Ambassadors'.

item.title: Tarcísio, sobre cancelamento do debate da TV Globo: Judiciário interferiu no debate público
item.description: Tarcísio criticized court decisions that preceded the cancellation of TV Globo's presidential debate, claiming the judiciary interfered in public debate. He compared judicial actions to a football referee who wants to influence the outcome of a game, warning about institutional discredit. Tarcísio emphasized the importance of self-restraint and respect for legal limits by judges.

item.title: Com 100 cargos, Secretaria de Apostas seguirá em vigor mesmo com fim das bets
item.description: Even after President Lula signed the Provisional Measure ending sports betting, the government decided to keep the Secretariat of Prizes and Bets, which currently has 100 positions. The measure aims to promote the legalization and regulation of the betting and gaming sector in Brazil. The decision was made following debates about transparency and oversight of sector operations.

item.title: Lula recua sobre limitar cartões e fala em proibir envios sem pedido
item.description: President Lula backtracked on his earlier proposal, stating he does not intend to limit the number of credit cards per person but wants to ban unsolicited card distribution and tackle abusive interest rates.

item.title: Tarcísio critica interferência do Judiciário no debate eleitoral
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized judicial interference in the electoral debate following the cancellation of a debate promoted by TV Globra. He argues that voters are the most harmed and that the judiciary risks losing credibility due to excessive intervention in the electoral process.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula encerra campanha no Rio sem Eduardo Paes
item.description: Lula concluded his re-election campaign in Rio de Janeiro with support from Pedro Paulo, Benedita da Silva, Eduardo Cavalieri and other allies, while Eduardo Paes did not attend the event. The rally featured speeches and mobilization of supporters in the city.

item.title: MPE defende que o TSE mantenha candidatura de Deltan Dallagnol ao Senado
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry (MPE) defends that the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) maintain the candidacy of Deltan Dallagnol for the Senate in Paraná, rejecting the ineligibility imposed in 2022 by arguing that ineligibility criteria must be reassessed in each election and that previous disciplinary proceedings were archived without punishment.

item.title: Canadá emite alerta para o Brasil, cita eleições e consulados dos EUA
item.description: The Canadian government updated its travel advisory for Brazil, reinforcing the recommendation for 'a high degree of caution' due to crime and violence, and included information about security during the Brazilian general elections. The advisory also highlights the suspension of US consular services in the country for security reasons. The first round of elections is scheduled for October 4th, with a possible second round on October 25th.

item.title: Campanha de Lula teme que Bolsonaro use saúde para ajudar Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign fears that Jair Bolsonaro may use a potential health issue to mobilize his base and boost his son Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy in the 2026 elections. The concern intensified after Damares Alves released a video about an alleged health episode of the former president, although she clarified it was an old recording mistakenly published. The strategy would be to use emotional appeal to benefit Flávio's candidacy.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula tentará “gols de mão” e faz apelo por voto útil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula of attempting 'handball goals' and questioned the interference of 'friends in the judiciary' following the cancellation of the Globo debate. He also called for votes in the first round, comparing voters to the VAR to decide whether the handball should be overturned.

item.title: STF libera plano de dados para combate a desinformação a 72h da eleição
item.description: The STF unanimously approved a data plan to combat misinformation 72 hours before the 2026 elections, in a historic ruling that brought together all justices, including Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça. The measure aims to contain fake news and ensure the integrity of the electoral process.

item.title: Globo não fez debates em 94 e 98; FHC venceu no 1º turno, e Lula reclamou
item.description: The cancellation of Globo's presidential debate revives criticism about the absence of debates in 1994 and 1998, elections in which FHC won in the first round and Lula questioned transparency. The incident reopens discussions about the media's role in election coverage and the importance of presidential debates for Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Mendonça manda apagar posts que ligam Flávio a Nossa Senhora
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of posts linking presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to support for stripping Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: PF planeja criar divisão de combate a bets ilegais
item.description: The Federal Police plans to create a specialized division to combat illegal gambling, with approval from President Lula. The directorate restructuring aims to strengthen repression of this type of criminal activity in the country.

item.title: Ao fechar consulados, EUA tentam criar narrativa de instabilidade na eleição brasileira
item.description: The U.S. Embassy in Brazil decided to close its consulates during the 2026 elections, an action interpreted as an interference attempt to create a narrative of instability in the country. Brazilian authorities view the measure as a 'factoid' without real security risks justifying the suspension of diplomatic services.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: TV Globo é alvo de censura do TSE e do STF; eleições livres acabaram?
item.description: The program Meio-Dia em Brasília discusses the cancellation of the TV Globo presidential debate, questioning censorship by the TSE and STF. The content includes criticism of institutional behavior and raises concerns about electoral freedom in Brazil.

item.title: Governo instala grades de proteção no Palácio do Planalto para as eleições
item.description: The GSI installed fences around the Palácio do Planalto ahead of the first round of the 2026 elections, citing potential nearby protests. The Ministries Esplanade and the Three Powers Plaza will also be closed Sunday for security reinforcement. Candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) held a protest against the STF following the cancellation of a TV Globo debate.

item.title: Nunes Marques reconsidera decisão e autoriza telões em comícios de Lula
item.description: The president of the TSE, Nunes Marques, authorized the use of screens in Lula's rallies, after revisiting a prior decision that banned them. The authorization allows real-time broadcast of the event’s images, but prohibits using the panels as independent advertising materials. The decision balances electoral regulations with transparency requirements in public events.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba a ordem dos votos na urna eletrônica
item.description: In the 2026 election, voters will make six choices at the ballot: federal deputy, state deputy, two senators, governor, and president. The order is set by the TSE, and voting takes place from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The electronic ballot includes a security pause for review before confirmation.

item.title: Ministra do TSE que proibiu púlpito vazio na Globo atuou com Dino e já pediu voto a Lula
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha blocked TV Globo from displaying an empty podium for Lula, leading to the cancellation of the presidential debate. Aranha, who previously worked in Flávio Dino's government and publicly supported Lula in 2022, was appointed to the TSE by President Lula. Additional judicial rulings, including the inclusion of Renan Santos and Romeu Zem, also modified the debate format.

item.title: Crusoé: O que os nossos juízes ainda vão aprontar nesta eleição?
item.description: The 2026 election is approaching its first round with Lula in his third term. Judges from the TSE are under pressure to oversee the electoral process. The campaign has been restricted by TSE's strict rules, raising concerns about transparency and freedom of expression.

item.title: Ministra eleitora de Lula no TSE resguardou o presidente, mas penalizou o eleitor
item.description: The TSE electoral minister's decision protected President Lula, prioritizing the collective right over the individual but penalized voters. Electoral justice applied the principle that the collective prevails, sparking criticism about its impact on voter participation.

item.title: Três em cada 10 pessoas no Brasil dizem que redes sociais são obstáculo para democracia, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Pew Research Center survey reveals that 29% of Brazilians consider social media a threat to democracy, while 78% say the internet facilitates manipulation through false information. Despite this, most people value access to information and expanded political participation enabled by digital platforms.

item.title: Eleições 2026: As capas do GLOBO nas datas de nascimento dos principais candidatos à Presidência
item.description: The article connects the births of the main 2026 presidential candidates with key historical and political moments in Brazil, emphasizing how each date overlaps with significant national events. Beyond Lula, Caiado, Cury, Zema, Flávio Bolsonaro and Renan Santos, the text underscores the relationship between each candidate's trajectory and the context in which they were born.

item.title: Fraco desempenho de Caiado e Zema é alerta para futuro de Tarcísio
item.description: The weak performance of Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema in the 2026 presidential polls serves as a warning for Tarcísio de Freitas, who is expected to be reelected in São Paulo. Despite his favorable position, the former governors did not exceed 5% in voting intention, indicating difficulties for candidates with traditional executive management in this polarized scenario. Tarcísio is likely to leave the election even more presidential, but must heed the warning signals from colleagues who also had well-regarded administrations.

item.title: Mendonça orienta plataformas sobre posts do caso Nossa Senhora
item.description: Minister André Mendonça (STF/TSE) instructed digital platforms to remove posts falsely attributing to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) a proposal to revoke Nossa Senhora Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint. Removal is limited to false attributions, preserving political criticism and religious statements. Legal disputes may be reassessed by Electoral Justice.

item.title: O que os governos dos EUA e da Austrália dizem sobre fechamento de embaixadas e consulados no Brasil às vésperas da eleição
item.description: The governments of the United States and Australia closed their embassies and consulates in Brazil on the eve of the 2026 presidential election, whose first round takes place on Sunday. The closure was motivated by security concerns, according to Australia, while the U.S. emphasized the priority of protecting its citizens.

item.title: “Democracias maduras não têm medo de serem observadas”, diz diretora do TSE
item.description: Renata Gil, Director of International Affairs at the TSE, emphasized that mature democracies do not fear external observation, stating that transparency strengthens Brazilian democracy. The court will host international missions to monitor the 2026 elections.

item.title: Cury pede a Fachin que STF preserve a liberdade de expressão nas eleições
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) wrote to Edson Fachin asking the STF to protect freedom of expression and ensure voters' information after the cancellation of TV Globo's debate. Cury criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's absence, noting 40% of voters are unaware of his candidacy.
